children.text: Introduction (Topic & Choice)
children.cn: 引言（主题与选择）

children.text: I am excited to share my predictions about life in 2055.
children.cn: 我很高兴能分享我对2055年生活的预测。
children.notes: be excited to do sth.: 做某事感到兴奋/高兴; predictions about: 关于……的预测
children.statement: “prediction” 是动词 “predict” 的名词形式。
children.explanation: predict（动词，预测）加后缀 -ion 构成名词 prediction（预测，预言）。

children.text: Among all the changes, I look forward to smart transport the most.
children.cn: 在所有的变化中，我最期待智能交通。
children.notes: among: 在……之中; look forward to: 期待; smart transport: 智能交通
children.statement: “look forward to” 后的 to 是不定式符号，后面必须接动词原形。
children.explanation: “look forward to” 中的 to 是介词，后面接名词、代词或动名词（v-ing）。
children.keywords: among, changes, look forward to, smart transport

children.text: Detailed Benefits
children.cn: 具体益处与改变

children.text: In 2055, all vehicles will run on clean energy like solar power.
children.cn: 到2055年，所有车辆都将使用太阳能等清洁能源运行。
children.notes: vehicles: 车辆; run on: 以……为动力运行; clean energy: 清洁能源; solar power: 太阳能
children.statement: “clean energy” 意为“清洁能源”，如太阳能、风能等。
children.explanation: clean energy 指对环境污染极小或无污染的绿色能源。
children.keywords: vehicles, run on, clean energy, solar power

children.text: This will reduce air pollution and keep our sky blue.
children.cn: 这将减少空气污染并保持我们的天空蔚蓝。
children.notes: reduce: 减少; air pollution: 空气污染; keep + 宾语 + 形容词: 使……保持某种状态
children.statement: “pollution” 在本句中作可数名词使用。
children.explanation: pollution（污染）通常作为不可数名词使用。
children.keywords: reduce, air pollution, keep sky blue

children.text: Besides, flying cars will become very popular in cities.
children.cn: 此外，飞行汽车将在城市中变得非常普及。
children.notes: besides: 此外，而且（副词）; flying cars: 飞行汽车; become popular: 变得受欢迎/普及
children.statement: “flying” 在这里是动名词作主语。
children.explanation: “flying” 是现在分词作定语，修饰 cars，表示“能飞行的汽车”。
children.keywords: besides, flying cars, become popular, in cities

children.text: They can fly in the sky, so there will be no traffic jams on roads.
children.cn: 它们可以在天空中飞行，所以道路上将不再有交通拥堵。
children.notes: fly in the sky: 在天空飞行; so: 所以; there will be: 将会有; traffic jams: 交通拥堵
children.statement: “traffic jam” 意为“交通拥堵”，jam 为可数名词。
children.explanation: traffic jam（堵车）是常用短语，复数形式为 traffic jams。
children.keywords: fly, sky, no traffic jams, roads

children.text: Also, AI systems will drive automatically to keep every trip safe.
children.cn: 而且，人工智能系统将自动驾驶以确保每次行程的安全。
children.notes: AI systems: 人工智能系统; drive automatically: 自动驾驶; keep safe: 保持安全
children.explanation: 副词 automatically 意为“自动地”，在句中修饰动词 drive。
children.keywords: AI systems, drive automatically, keep safe

children.text: Conclusion
children.cn: 总结展望

children.text: I believe smart transport will make our future lives greener and more convenient.
children.cn: 我相信智能交通将使我们未来的生活更加绿色和便利。
children.notes: believe: 相信（后接宾语从句）; make + 宾语 + 宾补: 使……变得……; convenient: 便利的
children.statement: “greener” 和 “more convenient” 都是形容词比较级作宾语补足语。
children.explanation: make our future lives greener and more convenient 结构中，形容词比较级并列作宾补。
children.keywords: believe, smart transport, make future lives, greener, convenient

tree.text: Life in 2055: A Green Transport Revolution

children.text: Introduction (Topic & Vision)
children.cn: 引言（主题与展望）

children.text: I am thrilled to share my visions for the School Future Forum about life in 2055.
children.cn: 我非常激动能为学校未来论坛分享我对2055年生活的展望。
children.notes: be thrilled to do sth.: 非常激动/兴奋地做某事; visions for: 对……的愿景/构想; School Future Forum: 学校未来论坛
children.statement: “thrilled” 表达的情感比 “pleased” 或 “happy” 更加强烈。
children.explanation: thrilled 意为“极其激动的，非常兴奋的”，比 happy 语气更强烈。
children.keywords: thrilled, share visions, School Future Forum, life in 2055

children.text: Among numerous technological breakthroughs, intelligent transportation will definitely bring the most revolutionary changes to our daily life.
children.cn: 在众多的技术突破中，智能交通无疑将给我们的日常生活带来最具革命性的改变。
children.notes: numerous: 众多的; technological breakthroughs: 技术突破; intelligent transportation: 智能交通; definitely: 必定，无疑; revolutionary: 革命性的
children.statement: “breakthrough” 是由 “break” 和 “through” 构成的复合名词。
children.explanation: breakthrough 意为“重大突破，新发现”，是可数名词。
children.keywords: numerous breakthroughs, intelligent transportation, revolutionary changes

children.text: Detailed Advantages
children.cn: 具体优势与解决的问题

children.text: To begin with, all vehicles will be powered by renewable clean energy, which will effectively reduce carbon emissions and tackle global climate change.
children.cn: 首先，所有车辆都将由可再生清洁能源驱动，这将有效减少碳排放并应对全球气候变化。
children.notes: to begin with: 首先; be powered by: 由……提供动力; renewable clean energy: 可再生清洁能源; which: 引导非限制性定语从句; carbon emissions: 碳排放; tackle: 应对，处理
children.statement: 句中的 “which” 引导非限制性定语从句，指代先行词整个主句的内容。
children.explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰前面“所有车辆由清洁能源驱动”这一事实。
children.keywords: to begin with, powered by, renewable clean energy, reduce carbon emissions, tackle climate change

children.text: Furthermore, 3D flying cars and underwater express lines will completely reshape urban travel.
children.cn: 此外，3D飞行汽车和水下特快通道将彻底重塑城市出行。
children.notes: furthermore: 此外，而且; express lines: 特快线路/通道; reshape: 重塑; urban travel: 城市出行
children.explanation: urban 意为“城市的”，其反义词为 rural（乡村的，农村的）。
children.keywords: furthermore, flying cars, express lines, reshape urban travel

children.text: Because they utilize sky and water routes, ground traffic jams will become a thing of the past.
children.cn: 因为它们利用天空和水上航线，地面交通堵塞将成为过去式。
children.notes: utilize: 利用; sky and water routes: 空中与水上路线; a thing of the past: 过去的事情，历史陈迹
children.statement: “a thing of the past” 是一个地道习语，表示“已成过往的事物”。
children.explanation: a thing of the past 意为“已经过时/成为历史的事物”。
children.keywords: because, utilize sky and water routes, traffic jams, a thing of the past

children.text: In addition, advanced AI autopilots will guarantee zero accidents and make long-distance travel effortless.
children.cn: 此外，先进的人工智能自动驾驶系统将保证零事故，并使长途旅行变得毫不费力。
children.notes: in addition: 此外; advanced AI autopilots: 先进的AI自动驾驶系统; guarantee: 保证; effortless: 毫不费力的，轻松的
children.statement: “effortless” 带有否定后缀 “-less”，表示“无需费力的”。
children.explanation: effort（努力）+ -less（无……的）构成形容词 effortless，意为“容易的，不费吹灰之力的”。
children.keywords: in addition, AI autopilots, guarantee zero accidents, effortless

children.text: Conclusion
children.cn: 总结与呼吁

children.text: All in all, smart transport will build a greener, safer, and faster world for all of us.
children.cn: 总而言之，智能交通将为我们所有人构建一个更绿色、更安全、更快速的世界。
children.notes: all in all: 总而言之; build: 构建; safer, greener, faster: 比较级并列
children.statement: “All in all” 常用在文末引出总结性观点。
children.explanation: All in all 意为“总的说来，总而言之”，是常用的总结过渡短语。
children.keywords: all in all, smart transport, build, greener, safer, faster
